name: vlm_shape_benchmark_1000
description: vlm_shape_benchmark_1000 is a small benchmark of 1,000 shape-focused visual instances designed to evaluate vision–language models' ability to recognize shapes and simple geometric attributes and to answer shape-related questions. It measures model performance on visual question answering and attribute classification involving shape reasoning.
reputation: Small, niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for VLM shape/attribute probes.
